title: For PR 4: under a hold the chat mirror holds the page's profile beside the newly read medication and screening lists; and an own-save read that began before a whole re-read can write the page's earlier profile after that re-read
evidence: Root fix R13 PR 4 (2026-11-25), US-34 AC10: the own-save read writes the mirror from one source chosen as it writes (useRecordReads ShownCopy): under a hold the page's saved profile and lists (useRecordApply lists), else the record read. Left: a medication or screening save under a hold writes the store's lists, the held change's included (useListSaves.ts mirrorSavedLists).
